purpose: Block submission when source-required indent information is missing and identify the missing information.
preconditions: An employee can submit an indent.
action_or_input: Submit an indent with one or more of item details, quantity, estimated cost, or justification missing.
expected_result: Submission is blocked and the missing required information is identified.

purpose: Allow submission when all source-required indent information is present.
preconditions: An employee can submit an indent.
action_or_input: Submit an indent containing item details, quantity, estimated cost, and justification.
expected_result: The completeness rule does not block submission.

purpose: Route an indent to internal issue when sufficient allocable departmental or central stock is available.
preconditions: A submitted indent requires fulfilment.
Sufficient allocable stock is available in departmental or central stock records.
action_or_input: Process the indent for fulfilment.
expected_result: The system checks stock and routes the indent to internal issue.

purpose: Route an indent toward external procurement when sufficient allocable stock is unavailable.
preconditions: A submitted indent requires fulfilment.
Departmental and central stock together do not provide sufficient allocable stock.
action_or_input: Process the indent for fulfilment.
expected_result: The system checks stock and routes the indent toward external procurement.

purpose: Verify approval routing follows the configured hierarchy and applicable cost threshold.
preconditions: An indent requires approval or recommendation.
A configured approval hierarchy and applicable cost threshold determine the required authority.
action_or_input: Submit the indent for approval.
expected_result: The indent is routed to the authority required by the configured hierarchy and threshold.

purpose: Require a justification before an approver can reject an indent.
preconditions: An indent is awaiting an approver's decision.
action_or_input: Attempt to reject the indent without recording a justification.
expected_result: The rejection is not completed without a justification.

purpose: Verify a justified rejection updates the indent, notifies the requestor, and is auditable.
preconditions: An indent is awaiting an approver's decision.
action_or_input: Reject the indent with a justification.
expected_result: The indent is set to rejected, the requestor is notified, and the decision is retained in the audit trail.

source_id: BR-PSM-006 lifecycle event notifications and history
purpose: Verify notifications and communication-history retention for specified lifecycle events.
preconditions: Relevant stakeholders and notification settings are configured.
action_or_input: Exercise each event as a parameterized case: submission, approval, dispatch, receipt, invoice, payment, SLA reminder, and SLA escalation.
expected_result: For each event, the applicable notification is sent to configured relevant stakeholders and the resulting communication history is retained.

purpose: Allow modification, withdrawal, or cancellation only when the indent is in a policy-designated permissible state.
preconditions: An existing indent is in a state designated permissible by configured procurement policy.
action_or_input: Attempt modification, withdrawal, and cancellation as separate parameterized cases.
expected_result: Each requested action is allowed when permitted by policy; a modification is saved as a new version and re-enters the applicable review path.

purpose: Block modification, withdrawal, or cancellation when the indent is not in a policy-designated permissible state.
preconditions: An existing indent is in a state not designated permissible by configured procurement policy.
action_or_input: Attempt modification, withdrawal, and cancellation as separate parameterized cases.
expected_result: Each action is blocked.

purpose: Verify external procurement uses direct procurement when required by configured thresholds and policy.
preconditions: An indent is routed for external procurement.
Configured thresholds and policy require direct procurement for this case.
action_or_input: Process the indent's procurement method.
expected_result: Direct procurement is selected.

purpose: Verify external procurement uses tender procurement when required by configured thresholds and policy.
preconditions: An indent is routed for external procurement.
Configured thresholds and policy require tender procurement for this case.
action_or_input: Process the indent's procurement method.
expected_result: Tender procurement is selected.

source_id: BR-PSM-009 confirmed receipt without unresolved discrepancy
purpose: Verify a confirmed receipt without unresolved discrepancy can proceed to final stock posting and payment release, subject to other required conditions.
preconditions: Goods have been delivered.
Receipt is accepted and delivery is confirmed.
No delivery discrepancy is unresolved.
Other payment eligibility conditions are satisfied.
action_or_input: Complete the receipt and evaluate final stock posting and payment eligibility.
expected_result: Final stock posting and payment release are not blocked by the receipt-confirmation or discrepancy gate.

purpose: Verify an unresolved delivery discrepancy blocks final stock posting and payment release.
preconditions: Goods have been delivered.
A delivery discrepancy remains unresolved.
action_or_input: Attempt final stock posting and payment release.
expected_result: Discrepancy handling is opened and both final stock posting and payment release are blocked until resolution.

source_id: BR-PSM-010 high-value final approval approved path
purpose: Verify the configured high-value final-approval route and return to PS Admin after approval.
preconditions: Configured policy requires Director/Registrar final review.
The Procurement & Stores Admin has made a recommendation.
action_or_input: Route the recommendation for final review and approve the procurement.
expected_result: The recommendation is routed to the Director/Registrar, and approved procurement returns to the Procurement & Stores Admin for PO/tender execution.

source_id: BR-PSM-010 high-value final approval rejected path
purpose: Verify a rejected high-value final review closes the indent as rejected with justification.
preconditions: Configured policy requires Director/Registrar final review.
The Procurement & Stores Admin has made a recommendation.
action_or_input: Reject the recommendation with a justification.
expected_result: The indent is closed as rejected and the justification is recorded.

purpose: Block PO issuance and payment for a vendor whose required master data is unverified.
preconditions: A vendor lacks verification of one or more required categories: GST details, bank details, or required compliance documents.
action_or_input: Attempt PO issuance and vendor payment as separate parameterized cases.
expected_result: Both PO issuance and payment are blocked while the vendor is unverified.

purpose: Allow PO issuance or payment to continue past the vendor-verification gate when required master data is verified.
preconditions: The vendor's required GST details, bank details, and compliance documents are verified.
Other applicable conditions for the attempted action are satisfied.
action_or_input: Attempt PO issuance or vendor payment.
expected_result: The vendor-verification gate permits continuation.

source_id: BR-PSM-013 stock reservation and allocable availability
purpose: Verify reserved stock is excluded from availability and remains reserved through the relevant dispatch/receipt lifecycle.
preconditions: Stock is allocated to an internal issue or approved transfer.
action_or_input: Reserve the allocated quantity, query allocable availability, and exercise the relevant dispatch/receipt lifecycle.
expected_result: The reserved quantity is excluded from available stock, preventing over-commitment, and remains reserved until the relevant lifecycle releases or consumes it.

source_id: BR-PSM-014 configured SLA reminder and escalation
purpose: Verify pending approval actions trigger configured reminders and escalation notifications and are audited.
preconditions: An approval action is pending.
Configured SLA rules define a reminder or escalation condition.
action_or_input: Advance the pending action to each configured reminder and escalation condition as parameterized cases.
expected_result: The configured reminder or escalation notification is issued and the event is retained in the audit trail.

purpose: Verify higher-criticality indents receive configured approval-queue priority where policy provides it.
preconditions: Multiple approval tasks are pending.
Configured policy specifies priority behavior for higher-criticality indents.
action_or_input: Place a higher-criticality indent in the approval queue with other pending tasks.
expected_result: The queue applies the configured priority behavior.

purpose: Flag a potential duplicate for Department Admin review before procurement continues.
preconditions: Configured comparison criteria identify a submitted new or modified indent as a potential duplicate.
action_or_input: Submit the new or modified indent.
expected_result: The indent is flagged for Department Admin review before procurement continues; it is not silently merged or automatically cancelled.

purpose: Verify an indent not identified as a potential duplicate is not flagged by duplicate detection.
preconditions: A new or modified indent is submitted.
Configured comparison criteria do not identify it as a potential duplicate.
action_or_input: Submit the indent for processing.
expected_result: Duplicate detection does not flag the indent as a potential duplicate.

purpose: Allow payment eligibility only when all required PO, receipt, verification, delivery-confirmation, and vendor-verification conditions are satisfied.
preconditions: A required PO exists.
The relevant GRN/receipt is accepted.
Invoice verification is complete.
Delivery confirmation requirements are satisfied.
Vendor verification is valid.
action_or_input: Accounts evaluates the invoice for payment.
expected_result: Payment is marked eligible.

purpose: Hold payment when any required payment eligibility condition is not satisfied.
preconditions: A required payment eligibility condition is unsatisfied; exercise each condition as a parameterized case: required PO, accepted receipt, completed invoice verification, delivery confirmation, or valid vendor verification.
action_or_input: Accounts evaluates the invoice for payment.
expected_result: Payment is not marked eligible and is held with the reason recorded.

purpose: Place a mismatched invoice on hold and prevent payment release until the mismatch is resolved.
preconditions: Three-way matching identifies a mismatch among the PO, GRN, and invoice.
action_or_input: Complete invoice verification and attempt payment release.
expected_result: The invoice/payment is placed on hold, the reason is recorded, responsible parties are notified, and payment is not released until resolution.

purpose: Verify the mismatch-hold rule does not hold an invoice when the required three-way match has no mismatch.
preconditions: The PO, GRN, and invoice match as required.
action_or_input: Complete three-way matching.
expected_result: The invoice is not placed on hold by the mismatch rule.

source_id: BR-PSM-019 resolved return replacement or warranty case
purpose: Verify a resolved return, replacement, or warranty case applies policy-required inventory and accounting adjustments and remains traceable.
preconditions: A return, replacement, or warranty case has an approved or recorded resolution.
Applicable policy specifies the required adjustments.
action_or_input: Record the resolution.
expected_result: Required inventory and accounting adjustments are applied and the resolution history remains traceable.

purpose: Permit an authorized user to access a function or information within their authorized role.
preconditions: A user has an authorized role for the requested function or information.
action_or_input: Access the function or information.
expected_result: Access is permitted.

purpose: Deny access to a function or information when the user's role does not authorize it.
preconditions: A user does not have an authorized role for the requested function or information.
action_or_input: Attempt to access the function or information.
expected_result: Access is denied.

purpose: Verify material module actions retain audit information sufficient to identify actor, action, target, resulting state, and timestamp.
preconditions: A user can perform a material module action.
action_or_input: Perform the action and inspect its audit record.
expected_result: The audit record contains the actor, action, target, resulting state, and timestamp sufficient for audit.

purpose: Verify an indent modification is retained as a distinct version.
preconditions: An indent is in a policy-permissible state for modification.
action_or_input: Modify the indent.
expected_result: A new indent version is retained, with the change auditable.

purpose: Verify vendor master changes retain audit records sufficient for audit.
preconditions: A vendor master record can be changed.
action_or_input: Change the vendor master record and inspect its audit record.
expected_result: The change is auditable with actor, action, target, resulting state, and timestamp sufficient for audit.

purpose: Record a partial receipt and preserve the remaining open balance or state.
preconditions: A delivery is partial.
action_or_input: Record the received portion as a partial GRN/receipt.
expected_result: The partial receipt is recorded and the remaining balance or state remains open.

source_id: BR-PSM-022 partial payment supported by accepted receipt and invoice verification
purpose: Allow only the policy-determined payable portion supported by accepted receipt and invoice verification.
preconditions: An invoice or delivery is partial.
A quantity or amount is supported by accepted receipt and invoice verification.
Configured payment rules determine a payable portion.
action_or_input: Evaluate and release the partial payment under configured rules.
expected_result: Only the policy-determined supported payable portion may be released, and the remaining balance or state is retained.

purpose: Prevent partial payment for quantities or amounts unsupported by accepted receipt or invoice verification.
preconditions: An invoice or delivery is partial.
The proposed payment portion is not supported by accepted receipt or invoice verification.
action_or_input: Evaluate and attempt the proposed partial payment.
expected_result: The unsupported portion is not released.

source_id: BR-PSM-023 tender evaluation and committee approval
purpose: Require evaluation against defined tender criteria and a recorded committee decision before selected procurement proceeds.
preconditions: A tender has received bids and reached evaluation.
action_or_input: Evaluate bids against the defined criteria and record the committee selection decision and approval.
expected_result: The evaluation and committee decision/approval are recorded with traceability before the selected procurement proceeds.

purpose: Prevent selected tender procurement from proceeding before the committee decision or approval is recorded.
preconditions: A tender has received bids and reached evaluation.
The committee decision or approval has not been recorded.
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed with the selected procurement.
expected_result: The selected procurement does not proceed until the committee decision and approval are recorded.

purpose: Permit an authorized user to request a report, dashboard, filter, or export and log each report generation event.
preconditions: A user is authorized for the requested reporting function.
action_or_input: Request a report, dashboard, filtered report, or export as separate parameterized cases.
expected_result: The authorized request is available and each report generation event is logged.

purpose: Restrict report, dashboard, filter, and export access to authorized users.
preconditions: A user is not authorized for the requested reporting function.
action_or_input: Attempt report, dashboard, filtered report, or export access as separate parameterized cases.
expected_result: The unauthorized request is denied.

purpose: Verify scheduled report generation validates the configured schedule and report authorization, then logs generation.
preconditions: A configured report-generation schedule becomes due.
action_or_input: Run the scheduled report generation with an authorized configuration, then exercise an unauthorized report configuration as a separate parameterized case.
expected_result: Generation occurs only when the configured schedule and report authorization are valid; each report generation event is logged.

purpose: Verify vendor master creation or change retains a version record and audit entry.
preconditions: Vendor master maintenance is available.
action_or_input: Create a vendor master record and change a vendor master record as separate parameterized cases.
expected_result: Each creation or change persists a version/change record and audit entry so prior values and changes remain traceable.

purpose: Post stock only for accepted receipt quantities when confirmation conditions are satisfied.
preconditions: A goods receipt is recorded with accepted quantities and delivery confirmation conditions satisfied.
action_or_input: Complete receipt processing and inspect final stock posting.
expected_result: Stock is posted only for accepted receipt quantities.

purpose: Prevent final stock posting of rejected or unresolved-discrepancy quantities.
preconditions: A goods receipt includes rejected quantities or quantities with an unresolved discrepancy.
action_or_input: Complete receipt processing and inspect final stock posting.
expected_result: Rejected and unresolved-discrepancy quantities are not finally posted; discrepant quantities remain unresolved.

purpose: Verify destination receipt confirmation completes the transfer, updates both stock ledgers, and retains an audit trail.
preconditions: An inter-departmental stock transfer has been dispatched.
action_or_input: Confirm receipt at the destination.
expected_result: The transfer is completed, source and destination stock ledgers are updated, and the transfer completion is logged.

purpose: Verify transfer ledger posting does not occur before destination receipt confirmation.
preconditions: An inter-departmental stock transfer has been dispatched but destination receipt is not confirmed.
action_or_input: Inspect transfer completion and source and destination stock ledgers.
expected_result: The transfer is not completed by the confirmation-triggered posting rule, and the ledgers are not updated by that rule.

source_id: BR-PSM-028 configured procurement and financial policy
purpose: Verify a configured procurement or financial rule is applied before a governed action proceeds.
preconditions: A governed action is subject to a configured procurement or financial policy rule.
action_or_input: Attempt the governed action under conditions that do not satisfy the applicable configured rule.
expected_result: The action does not proceed until the applicable configured rule is satisfied.
